verdict.rationale: Close documents a public REST API that covers leads, contacts, opportunities, custom objects, bulk actions, email/SMS and the event log. It also offers API-key and OAuth authentication, rate-limit headers, a changelog, and a published OpenAPI spec, which a probe confirmed returns a valid spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end through API calls, beyond the spec-existence probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Push leads, contacts, activities, and custom data into Close from your website or other systems via the REST API.
Full endpoint docs with schemas, examples, and an interactive API explorer.
We publish an OpenAPI spec at: https://api.close.com/api/openapi.json
Manage workflows with sequences or bulk actions, or send email/SMS programmatically.
API Keys — Best for scripts, internal tools, and server-side integrations... OAuth 2.0 — Best for user-facing integrations.
